title: Deaf in AI: AI language technologies and the erosion of linguistic rights

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative critique of AI development ecosystems, analyzing the lack of deaf leadership, the imposition of technological 'fixes' (technoableism), and the evaluation of systemic biases in sign language AI research through the lens of crip technoscience.

Theoretical examination of modality chauvinism (privileging spoken languages over sign languages) and the critical analysis of dataset biases, specifically the overreliance on interpreted sign language datasets instead of authentic deaf community languaging practices.
